# Sample code to test regex matching in file contents
import re

def test_regex_in_file(file_path, regex_pattern):
    with open(file_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as file:
        content = file.read()
        match = re.search(regex_pattern, content)
        print(f"Regex match found in {file_path}: {match is not None}")

# Example usage
test_regex_in_file('./files/example.txt', r'hello\s(you|world)')

# Sample code to test regex matching on file content
import re

def test_regex_matching(content, pattern):
    assert re.search(pattern, content) is not None, "Pattern did not match the content."

# Example usage
test_content = "Hello world, this is a test."
test_pattern = r"hello\s(world)"
test_regex_matching(test_content, test_pattern)
